method: Independent standard-library CSV/JSONL parsing, fresh greedy-constructor reconstruction, exact seeded SA draw/acceptance/cooling/best-route replay, and metrics. No project module imports or simulator executions. Identical constructor contexts are cached after independent reconstruction; every SA attempt in every run is replayed.
limitations: These are five development days with five seeded repetitions each, not25 independent days.
No pooled or mean score across days was selected; seed means and sample SD are reported separately per day.
Seeded variation does not establish statistical significance or performance on untested days.
Best dominance is per current constructor route; it does not guarantee higher complete-day service because earlier returns change later decisions.
